conditions: Requires the user consent string to comply with GDPR regulations
effects: Allows the SDK to manage user consent for GDPR

conditions: The consent string must be in accordance with the IAB TCFv2 framework
effects: Enables the Nimbus SDK to append the GDPR consent details to outbound requests

conditions: Must be called after setGdprConsent to apply the consent globally
effects: Overwrites the values set from setGdprConsent if called after

conditions: Requires a user object containing the consent string
effects: Sets the user information along with the consent for all requests

conditions: Must create a 4 character privacy string in accordance with CCPA
effects: Allows the SDK to manage user privacy preferences under CCPA

conditions: The privacy string must be initialized before any demand providers
effects: Enables the Nimbus SDK to apply the CCPA privacy settings

conditions: Necessary to comply with COPPA regulations if the app is governed by them
effects: Configures the SDK to send COPPA compliance information to demand partners

conditions: The app is under COPPA regulations
effects: Indicates that the app is intended for children and requires specific handling of personal data
